sources.title: Florida Statutes 2026, chapter 83 (Landlord and Tenant), part II: Residential Tenancies
sources.notes: Part II (ss. 83.40-83.684), cut from the statute markup of the chapter page (flsenate.gov serves the same bytes); parts I and III are not in the corpus. Florida Statutes 2026 is the official statute law (s. 11.2421). s. 83.5615 takes effect only upon the repeal of the federal Protecting Tenants at Foreclosure Act (its Note).

sources.title: Florida Statutes 2026, chapter 718 (Condominiums): ss. 718.110, 718.112 and 718.116
sources.notes: Sections 718.110, 718.112 and 718.116, cut in that order from the statute markup of the chapter page (flsenate.gov serves the same bytes); the rest of chapter 718 is not in the corpus. The provisions on tenancies: 718.110(13) (amendments restricting rentals), 718.112(2)(k) (lease approval fees and the association's security deposit) and 718.116(11) (rent demanded from the tenant of a delinquent owner).
